transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm here because... well, things have been really hard at work lately. I'm a hairstylist, and lately, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. Even simple things, like sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. People have started noticing that I’m just slower than I used to be. It's really frustrating.
Are you experiencing any difficulties or frustrations outside of work?

Yeah, it's kind of affecting everything. At the salon, I've actually lost trust from my manager and my regular clients because I keep making mistakes with basic routines, and like I said, I'm just working too slowly. I end up canceling on appointments and things I used to reliably handle. 

And outside of work... I guess I've just pulled away from my friends. I don't really see anyone right now. I even stopped showing up for the volunteer haircuts I used to do at the senior center. I just... I can't seem to keep up with any of it.
Are you experiencing any physical symptoms like pain or fatigue outside of the slowing down of your hands?
No, not really. I mean, I don't have any pain or anything like that. I'm just... tired all the time, I guess, but it's more like that heavy feeling I mentioned. It's not like my body actually hurts.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days, honestly. I just... I wake up with this heavy, flat kind of sadness right in my chest. It's just there all the time. It makes me feel like there's really no point in even trying to build the life I was planning for myself.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious. It's not really a nervous or worried feeling. It's more just... that heavy sadness I mentioned. I don't feel panicked or anything like that.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before your symptoms started?

Not really, no. I mean, I used to love chatting with my clients at the salon, and I'd always help out the newer stylists. I used to go hiking with my friends a lot, too. But now... I just don't have that spark in me anymore. I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don't really get any enjoyment out of those things right now.
How long have you been feeling this heavy sadness?
It's been a while now. I'd say... about a year and two months. That's how long this heavy depression has really been with me.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Honestly, no. Like I kind of just mentioned, I really don't. I used to get a lot out of chatting with my clients, or helping the newer stylists at the salon, and going hiking with my friends... but now I just don't have that spark in me for any of it. I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. There isn't really anything I look forward to doing right now.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?

I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do get these thoughts sometimes. Like, I'll just think that maybe it would be easier if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up. Then nobody would have to deal with me or worry about me anymore. It just feels like it would be simpler.
Have you experienced any significant weight loss or gain since your symptoms started?

Yeah, I've lost some weight. I haven't really been trying to, but I've just been skipping meals without really meaning to. I'll get to the end of the day and realize I've only had coffee and maybe a few bites of something. I've definitely noticed my clothes have gotten looser over the past few months.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or do you feel restless and like you can't sit still?

Definitely slower. I don't really feel restless, just... heavy, I guess. Like when I'm at work, my hands feel like they’re moving through glue. Even basic things like sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. And people have actually started noticing, too, that I’m just moving a lot slower than I used to be.
Have you experienced any psychomotor agitation or retardation in addition to the slowing down of your hands?
No, not really. It's just the slowing down. I don't feel restless or fidgety or anything like that. I just feel sluggish all over, but it's most obvious when I'm trying to work with my hands.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you have no interest in doing at all?

Yeah, definitely. I used to really enjoy chatting with my clients and helping out the newer stylists at the salon. And outside of work, I used to go hiking with my friends a lot. But now... I just don't have any interest in that stuff. I mostly just keep my head down at work and avoid people as much as I can. I just don't have that spark in me anymore to do any of it.
Are there any activities that you still find some pleasure in, even if it's not as much as you used to?

No, not really. I can't think of anything. I just... I don't really enjoy anything right now. Even the things I used to like, they just feel like a chore. I mostly just want to go to sleep and not have to do anything.
Have you experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt better, with fewer symptoms, since this heavy sadness started?

No, I haven't. It's just been a constant heavy feeling. I can't remember a time in the last few months where I felt any better or had a break from it. It's just been this same low mood the whole time.
